units.source_text: 最后，K终于决定恢复原来的户籍。

en.t: In the end, K finally decided to return to his original family register.

units.source_text: 养父家提供的学费由父母来赔偿。

en.t: The school expenses provided by his adoptive family would be repaid by his parents.

units.source_text: 但是父母表示今后也不会再负担他的学费，随他的便。

en.t: But his parents said they would no longer pay his school expenses from then on, and that he could do as he pleased.

units.source_text: 老话说，这就是断绝父子关系。

en.t: In old-fashioned terms, this was disowning him.

units.source_text: 也许没有那么严重，不过他是这样理解的。

en.t: It may not have been quite that severe, but that was how he understood it.

units.source_text: K的生母早逝，可以说，他性格的某一方面是在继母抚养下长大的结果。

en.t: K's birth mother had died early; one could say that one side of his character was the result of being raised by his stepmother.

units.source_text: 我想，如果他的生母还活着，或许他和自家的人也不至于产生这么大的隔膜。

en.t: I think that if his birth mother had still been alive, perhaps such a great distance would not have opened between him and his own family.

units.source_text: 他的父亲虽然是个僧侣，但在讲求人情这一点上，倒有点像个武士。

en.t: Although his father was a priest, when it came to honoring human obligations, he seemed rather like a samurai.
